answer: Concretely, the economy can chain each registration to a per-identity nonce derived from the prior epoch hash so clones collide. Near-duplicate embeddings collapse the farm into one cluster. Because it works by pricing registration in scarce verifiable compute instead of free signups, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The bridge of work and the ocean of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a forge to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
